FAQ

Common questions

Is this contact form template really free?

Yes. The template is free to use on FormflowX's free plan — up to 100 responses per month with no credit card required. Customise the questions, connect Google Sheets, and publish in minutes.

Can I embed this contact form on my website?

Yes. Every FormflowX form can be embedded via a small script tag on any website — WordPress, Webflow, Framer, Squarespace, or custom HTML. Or share it as a direct link from your nav or button.

How do I get notified when someone submits?

Email notifications are enabled by default — you'll receive an email for every submission immediately. On Pro, you can also connect Slack so your team gets notified in a channel.

Can I add more questions or change the order?

Yes, completely. All questions are editable — add, remove, reorder, or change types. You can also add conditional logic to show different questions based on earlier answers.

What if I need a spam filter?

FormflowX includes basic spam filtering on all plans. For high-volume forms, you can add an email verification step using conditional logic to confirm the respondent owns their email address before submitting.
